verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: reconcile Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, costs, mechanics, Counter Skills taxonomy, and reward-slot evidence. Preserve unsupported fields as null.
research_scope: God Breaker — Strike Super / melee counter research.

verification_audit.method: Reconciled repository research with Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No duplicate repository research batch was found; God Breaker remains a single Super Skill identity.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies God Breaker as a Ki Blast Super with a Strike Counter characteristic. The repository retains Super / Strike taxonomy for its melee-counter family while damage_type remains Ki Blast.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: God Breaker is obtainable by the Future Warrior from PQ44 — Dragon Balls of the Future. Independent Dragon Ball documentation also identifies the PQ44 route and later Tapion Partner Customization availability.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains false: the repository's all-186 PQ reward guide records God Breaker as a PQ44 basic reward rather than an Ultimate Finish reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: 100 Ki is directly documented; stamina cost remains null.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The counter activates when struck by Strike or basic melee attacks, including grabs, then stuns/turns toward the attacker and fires a yellow Ki Blast. Exact active-frame and damage values remain version-sensitive.

records.name: God Breaker
records.character_source: Trunks (Future) / Trunks and Tapion customizable partners
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 44 — Dragon Balls of the Future
records.skill_description: A Strike-counter Super that places the user in a defensive stance; when struck by a Strike or basic melee attack during the active window, the user stuns the attacker and fires a yellow Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: Xenoverse 2 documentation describes a defensive pose that counters Strike skills and basic melee attacks, including grabs. On activation the attacker is stunned, the user turns toward the triggering opponent, and a yellow Ki Blast is fired. The move is categorized as a Ki Blast Super while functioning as a melee/Strike counter; this is not a taxonomy contradiction.
records.acquisition_notes: Future Warrior acquisition is PQ44 — Dragon Balls of the Future. The all-186 reward guide places it in the Basic Reward slot; exact random-drop probability remains unresolved. Partner Customization later permits Tapion access, which is cast-character customization rather than a separate CaC acquisition route.
records.pve_notes: PQ44 basic reward; no Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Melee/Strike counter that can also catch grabs. Detailed frame and matchup claims remain version-sensitive.
